data.body: Windows evidence, run 44503581058 (dispatched by another session at 92d3f373e2c, which contains 9e0fb47f8ff; it cancelled my run 44499548815), `sweep (windows)` job 135490319213. The command no longer passes `nested-pytest-plugins.args`. None of the 27 node ids appears in the job's failures, and none of the 5 modules carries a skip marker (grep for `skip|requires_` returns 0 in each), so all 27 ran and passed. The job itself concluded `failure`: 14 failed, 20016 passed. None of the 14 is from this change. 2 are in my livid test (filed as scholastic-travelsick-salmon). The other 12 are in test_store_paths, test_repo_root_from_package_guard, test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard, test_single_definition_helpers and test_uv_pin_guard (backslash paths in assertion text) and come from other changes. AC4 requires a `success` job, so this ticket stays open until a green sweep.
